learning_outcomes.text: Students will receive knowledge and skills to use in electrical practice.

syllabus_topics: Basic elements in electrical circuits, ways of connection
Notation of elements in electrical circuits
Types of electric measuring devices, measuring units, measurement errors
Basic elements in the systems for automatic control
Technologies for producing printed circuit boards
Architecture and programming of programmable logic controllers
Electrical Drive and Supply of Aggregates
teaching_methods: workshops (allowing independent acquaintance with electrical equipment)

assessment_methods.method: oral examining during lectures and workshops

assessment_rules: The colloquium is written and oral. Oral examining is done during the lectures and workshops.
